summary.name: AsmBB
summary.one_liner: AsmBB is a fast, SQLite-backed web forum engine written entirely in assembly language, and this site is its official support forum and demo/test installation.
use_cases: ask for support on the AsmBB project
try out a forum engine demo
summary.what_it_does: The page is the official support forum and demo/test installation for AsmBB, a forum engine described as written entirely in assembly language. It stores data in SQLite; the footer lists AsmBB v3.0 and SQLite v3.42.0. The visible content is a list of forum threads with post counts, view counts, ratings, and dates, covering topics such as assembly data structures and signup problems. The page lists the project as licensed under EUPL-1.2 and copyright John Found for 2016 to 2024. It is also listed in awesome-selfhosted under forums.
notable: Forum engine written entirely in assembly language
Official support forum and demo installation
caveats: The page shows a live demo; it does not describe installation steps or hosting requirements.
Recent threads report signup problems on this forum.
